faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about WatsStore and boosting your WhatsApp sales.
faq.q1: How does my store receive customer orders?
faq.a1: When customers select their items, sizes, and delivery address, they tap "Complete Order via WhatsApp". A detailed invoice message is instantly generated and sent to your WhatsApp.
faq.q2: Do I need a credit card to start the free trial?
faq.a2: No credit card is required. You get 14 days of full access completely free.
faq.q3: Can I track Facebook and Instagram Ads with Meta Pixel?
faq.a3: Yes! Pro and VIP plans include direct Meta Pixel integration with automated ViewContent, AddToCart, and Purchase event tracking.
faq.q4: What is the difference between store link and permanent QR code?
faq.a4: The web link is your online catalog URL, while the permanent QR code is a fixed shortcut you can print on packaging and business cards that never breaks.
